site.title: floating liars’ club
site.headline: floating liars’ club — reconstructed live from the surviving scans
site.dek: Three surviving issues from 2002–2003. Best current editorial structure by default; facsimile and reconstruction alternatives remain available as review progresses.

render_now: Collection homepage with title, deck, three issue cards, reconstruction-status summary, and source/facsimile entry point.
Issue pages using reviewed issue labels and contents/bylines from editorial-overlay.json.
Contents entries should be visible even when dedicated story reading routes are still held for editorial page-span mapping.
Page atlas/facsimile using site-feed.json thumbnails and exact source PDF links.
Compact best-guess/facsimile version control rather than forcing the reader to choose a raw technical view before reading.
do_not_render_as_primary: A bare PDF shelf or three embedded PDF viewers when this bundle is available.
Auto-only OCR as authoritative story text.
Invented story page spans or reading order.
The coarse image-heavy/text-heavy classifier from early private probes.
story_route_rule: Render known contents as editorial entities/cards now. Create dedicated story reading routes only when the story's page mapping/text layer reaches an appropriate review state; until then, the card may lead to the issue/facsimile context or display 'mapping in progress'.
fallback_rule: If editorial-overlay.json fails, fall back to site-feed.json page atlas. If site-feed.json fails, fall back to the original source PDFs. Record which fallback was used.

wanted: fields the renderer wished the bundle contained

consumer_instruction: Treat site-bundle.json as the first file to inspect for this reconstruction. It defines the current website experience. site-feed.json is the lower-level source/page feed, not the homepage information architecture. If this bundle_version or refresh_nonce changes, rebuild/reconcile the editorial presentation before falling back to the existing PDF viewer.
